rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unexpected result, event, or development.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 git3 gwo2 zan1 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Choose this when the surprising thing is especially striking in scale, degree, or effect.

example.english: Their sales figures this time are truly surprising.
example.traditional: 佢哋今次嘅銷售數字真係驚人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 ge3 siu1 sau6 sou3 zi6 zan1 hai6 ging1 jan4

rows.note: Use this when explicitly saying that something causes astonishment, especially in more formal phrasing.

example.jyutping: ni1 hong6 faat3 jin6 ling6 jan4 ging1 ngaa6
